The blocks check the intake with picker check (the step content) and the fixtures with the engine: REQ-111 criterion 5 (resolveAnswers accepts each, each solution recommended by one) and criterion 8 (parity with the original engine, AC1.7).

Two measured facts shape REQ-111 criteria 5 and 6 and are not in the plan: (1) the byte copy of tools/src/picker/engine.js fails `tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json` of app/ with 50 errors (TS7006; its code has no JSDoc), and a byte copy cannot be edited — with server/vendor excluded and a declaration file beside the copy tsc exits 0 (the form ARCH §2.2 gives worker/core-bridge.d.ts), so criterion 6 names a declaration file and compares its export names with the copy's; (2) picker check accepts price_text and duration_text (optional fields of the format), so the absence of prices is a test of its own (criterion 5). Default: in the production build — vercel-build writes the public set (no examples.html, no order_ key, no kk value, no link or button to them; every other file byte-equal; idempotent, because the platform runs it twice; refused in a git working tree), the function entry answers the demo only in ru and en, each gate is one constant of the source changed by a release after the owner's answer; REQ-109 criterion 8's sentence is replaced (I11).
